ticker_news.title: NexQloud Files Patent for Distributed Kubernetes Service (DKS) and Migrates Infrastructure from Amazon EKS
ticker_news.description: NexQloud has filed a patent for its Distributed Kubernetes Service (DKS), a decentralized cloud computing solution that integrates AI, blockchain, and energy-efficient hardware. The company is transitioning its infrastructure from Amazon EKS to its own DKS platform, offering enterprises a secure, scalable, and cost-effective alternative to traditional cloud solutions.
ticker_news.author: Nexqloud

ticker_news.title: Amazon EPS Jumps 86%, Beats Forecasts
ticker_news.description: Amazon reported strong Q4 2024 results, with revenue increasing 10.5% year-over-year to $187.8 billion and earnings per share soaring 86% to $1.86. The performance was driven by robust growth in Amazon Web Services and international markets, though high capital expenditures remain a challenge.
ticker_news.author: Jesterai
